_note: Sanitized shape of SK-3060 plan 721 v1: API cases on the public host, a boot-log step and a model-written build line that name the internal worker.

happy_path.title: Debug endpoint returns the fee breakdown for a known order
happy_path.preconditions: Staging runs the merged change: staging-east runs main-0954a53 (read the image tag in example-org/ops-deployments/team/calc-app/staging-east/values.yaml).
steps: Build check: read the image tag in example-org/ops-deployments/team/calc-app/ss-prod-west/values.yaml or example-org/ops-deployments/team/calc-app/staging-east/values.yaml and confirm it contains the merge.
Call GET https://calc-app-staging.example.com/api/trpc/gfeDebug.breakdown?input={"orderId":"<id>"} with a staff token
Confirm the response lists each fee line
happy_path.expected: 200 with a fee breakdown for the order

happy_path.title: Server boots with the new router registered
steps: Open the staging-east calc-app server pod logs in Grafana (Loki)
Find the startup line that lists registered tRPC routers
happy_path.expected: The startup line lists gfeDebug and the ping returns 200

edge_cases.title: Nightly fee rollup cron still runs after the change
steps: Wait for the nightly Agenda rollup job to run
Read the worker pod logs for the rollup completion line
